NVIDIA-JR2024801.title: Senior Silicon Product Methodology Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2024801.description:
Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) is a wide-ranging, multi-functional, integral team at NVIDIA. We sit at the crossroads of design, architecture, marketing, operations, and productization. Our contributions span from the arch stage and extend to defining final products. We architect innovative solutions for Datacenter, Server, Gaming, Robotics, Automotive, and Embedded markets. We are fast-paced, dynamic, share a sense of humor, and collaborate extensively to push the boundaries of what is possible. We do all of this with an eye on making groundbreaking, impactful market disruptions! We are looking for a Senior Silicon Product Methodology Engineer to define and implement the validation and screening of new silicon features within high-volume manufacturing flows. You will translate product requirements into executable test methodologies, infrastructure, and detailed manufacturing test plans that ensure quality, yield, and efficiency at scale. This role sits at the intersection of multiple cross-functional teams to make manufacturing test an outstanding part of the overall codesign and DFP (Design for Productization) lifecycle. This is a highly visible, multi-functional role focused on building DFP methodologies that help products meet SOL milestones and achieve the high NVIDIA quality bar our customers expect. Success in this role requires turning hard manufacturing and test problems into reusable methods, better decisions, and stronger production roadmaps.
What you will be doing:
Own end-to-end manufacturing methodology strategy, defining organization-wide standards adopted across teams, products, and future generations, and shaping how manufacturing issues are screened, debugged, and closed.
Translate system specs and product POR into DFP requirements, test content, coverage, flows, and testability requirements, and maintain the DFP roadmap across infrastructure planning, execution readiness, and sign-off alignment.
Partner multi-functionally to implement test content, debug hooks, and screening improvements, and drive alignment on manufacturability, test time, binning strategies, and cost-versus-coverage trade-offs.
Turn incomplete yield, coverage, and correlation issues into hypothesis trees, measurement plans, and executable paths to closure.
Define data and analytics frameworks to support yield analysis ,anomaly detection, and continuous improvement.
Lead methodology strategy and DFP documentation as the single source of truth and feed findings into future methodologies , reusable methods, and production decisions.
Create production-standard test methods, analytics systems, and debug frameworks that become durable artifacts adopted by engineering teams across products and future generations.
Build secure, traceable, and validated AI-assisted workflows for analysis, debug, documentation, and methodology automation, with human oversight for critical engineering judgments.
NVIDIA-JR2024801.requirements:
BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
8+ years in silicon post‑silicon validation and/or high‑volume manufacturing test for complex SoCs, GPUs, CPUs, or similar.
Hands‑on experience with test content bring‑up, limit setting, correlation to characterization, and yield/coverage optimization, and prior ownership of manufacturing test strategy from early planning through ramp to QS/production.
Proficiency with scripting and data analysis (e.g., Python, MATLAB, R, SQL) for test data analytics, limit tuning, and yield/debug analysis.
Demonstrated ability to frame ambiguous manufacturing problems, define evidence-driven trade-offs, and drive cross-functional alignment and closure around plans, dependencies, and sign-off criteria.
Excellent communication skills and comfort authoring structured technical documents and test plans used by global manufacturing and validation teams.
Strong AI-enabled skills and thinking, using AI to accelerate analysis, exploration, and documentation while maintaining rigor, originality, engineering judgment, clear validation guardrails, and measurable workflow impact.
Prior ownership of manufacturing test strategy for a major silicon product (e.g., GPU/SoC/CPU) from early planning through ramp to QS/production.
Track record creating reusable test methods, analytics frameworks, or debug tools adopted across teams, products, or programs.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Build production AI-assisted validation workflows with evaluation, observability, and guardrails, and drive measurable adoption across engineering teams
Proof of work: shipped manufacturing test methods, debug systems, analytics platforms, patents, or published technical works.
Share methods, tools, or workflows that become durable team standards and elevate engineering efficiency while maintaining technical rigor.
With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered one of the world's most desirable technology employers. We welcome you to join our team, which consists of some of the hardest-working people in the world, working together to promote rapid growth. Are you passionate about joining a best-in-class team supporting the latest in GPU and AI technology? If so, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA-JR2025845.title: Senior Silicon Validation Methodology Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2025845.description:
NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) is a wide-ranging, multi-functional team at NVIDIA. We sit at the crossroads of design, architecture, marketing, operations, and productization. Our contributions span from the architecture stage through final product definition. We architect solutions for Datacenter, Server, Gaming, Robotics, Automotive, and Embedded markets. We are fast-paced, collaborative, and focused on making groundbreaking, impactful products.
We are seeking a Senior Silicon Validation Methodology Engineer for Clocking and High-Speed I/O (PCIE, USB, MGBE, UFS etc) functional, you will own clocking and HSIO functional validation methodology for the products across GPU/SOC/CPU.
What you'll be doing:
Own the definition and first-use of clocking and HSIO functional validation methodology from specification through silicon bring-up, covering functional, protocol, SI/PI,  clocking behavior, system stability and integration test across corners and real bring-up conditions. Set the standard for validation so it is reused across a broad array of silicon products.
Define what needs to be tested, why, and how — including coverage bounds, timing vs. power, signal integrity vs. performance, coverage vs. test time, milestone expectations, and signoff guidance — and turn that into executable concrete test content, pass/fail criteria, and bring-up plans.
Drive cross-functional teams( architecture, design, board, FW, SW) collaboration to ensure robust methodology orchestration and alignment with validation design requirements, while also providing insights on trade-offs between coverage, schedule and effort.
Drive continuous improvement in validation methodologies by creating and standardizing automated tools, scripts, and metrics that enhance efficiency and coverage in the validation workflow.
NVIDIA-JR2025845.requirements:
A Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of hands-on silicon validation methodology experience, with deep understanding of HSIO and Clocking architecture, design and validation including SerDes, protocol, functional and electrical validation, SI/PI, and power-aware trade-offs, in at least one of PCIe, CXL, USB, UFS, MGBE, or chip-to-chip / die-to-die interconnects.
Demonstrated ability to set validation strategy under trade-offs such as functionality vs. power, signal integrity vs. performance, and coverage vs. test time, and to turn ambiguous specifications into executable tests.
Expert debug of silicon HSIO and clocking issues, and the ability to deconstruct ambiguous failures into simpler, reusable validation and corrective approaches that raise quality and efficiency for the org.
Strong collaboration skills and Proven track record of influencing and leading cross-functional/group(design, Board, FW, SW) consensus through product launches in low-power domains.
Strong AI-enabled skills and thinking — use AI to accelerate analysis, exploration, and documentation while maintaining rigor, originality, and judgment that do not come from AI.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Proven experience in creating novel methodologies in clocking and HSIO that have been incorporated into industry practices or standards.
Contributions to open-source tools or publications relevant to silicon validation methodologies, particularly in clocking or HSIO.
Familiarity with the latest trends in high-speed communication protocols and their impact on validation methodologies.
If you are energized by hard silicon problems, ownership of the validation method, and turning clocking and HSIO expertise into plans and tools your team can run, we'd love to talk to you.

NVIDIA-JR2025841.title: Senior Silicon Validation Methodology Engineer - Low Power
NVIDIA-JR2025841.description:
NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) is a wide-ranging, multi-functional team at NVIDIA. We sit at the crossroads of design, architecture, marketing, operations, and productization. Our contributions span from the architecture stage through final product definition. We architect solutions for Datacenter, Server, Gaming, Robotics, Automotive, and Embedded markets. We are fast-paced, collaborative, and focused on making groundbreaking, impactful products. We are seeking a Senior Silicon Validation Methodology Engineer for Low-Power (LPWR). You will own the department LPWR validation methodology across GPU, SoC, and CPU, from architecture to silicon to product.
What you'll be doing:
Own architecture, design, and first-use of end-to-end LPWR validation methodology from silicon to product, covering corners, edge conditions, variability, and real-world scenarios. Set the department standard for LPWR validation so it is reused across a broad array of silicon products.
Define what needs to be tested, why, and how — including coverage bounds, PVT/variability, test-time vs. schedule, signoff criteria, milestone playbooks, and SOL(speed of light) expectations.
Invent and land new LPWR validation approaches that go beyond extending an existing test plan. Challenge current paradigms on performance, power, idle vs. active behavior, and corner-case coverage, and drive the resulting methods, tools, and metrics into org default practice.
Set LPWR validation strategy and policy across teams, including long-lead items that outlive a single execution cycle. Translate architecture and product goals into multi-generation methodology, infrastructure, and tool investments.
Drive cross-functional consensus with Architecture, Design, Firmware, and Software under conflicting PPA, coverage, latency, and schedule priorities.
Improve validation workflow at department scale by building and adopting automation, coverage metrics, pre-silicon to post-silicon correlation, and AI-enabled analysis. Fold learnings back into methodology, spec, and design.
NVIDIA-JR2025841.requirements:
A Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of hands-on silicon validation methodology experience, with deep ownership of low-power architecture and design (idle power, power gating, clocking, DVFS, and related features) and silicon features tied to current energy-efficient design.
Proven record of creating new LPWR validation methods, tools, or signoff criteria that were adopted across multiple products or teams.
Expert debug of silicon LPWR issues, and the ability to deconstruct ambiguous failures into simpler, reusable validation and corrective approaches that raise quality and efficiency for the org.
Demonstrated strong ability to set validation strategy under hard trade-offs: functionality vs. performance/power, latency vs. coverage, and coverage vs. schedule.
Strong collaboration skills and Proven track record of influencing and leading cross-functional/group(design, Board, FW, SW) consensus through product launches in low-power domains.
Strong AI-enabled skills and thinking — use AI to accelerate analysis, exploration, and documentation while maintaining rigor, originality, and judgment that do not come from AI.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Set LPWR or power-management validation policy, playbooks, or signoff bars that other teams ran without you in the critical path.
Have shipped methodology reuse across multiple chips, SKUs, or platforms, with measurable impact such as higher coverage, fewer debug loops, lower SOL, or faster bring-up.
If you are energized by owning a domain, setting the bar for others, and turning low-power silicon expertise into reusable methodology at NVIDIA scale, we'd love to talk to you.

NVIDIA-JR2025055.title: Silicon Co-design Intern - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2025055.description:
NVIDIA's GPUs and SOCs are the world leaders in performance and efficiency, and we are continually innovating in creative and unique ways to improve our ability to deliver extraordinary solutions in a wide range of sectors. We are seeking engineers who are passionate about what they do and are committed to making a difference in the world through their inventions.
The Silicon Co-Design Group is where architecture intent becomes silicon reality. We own the boundary between what was designed and what was built, and we are the team that knows the difference. When a program ships at frequency and at quality, this team is a reason why.
What you will be doing:
Work proactively on GPU/SOC feature/IP bring-up and characterization including creating validation, tuning and optimization methodologies, develop proper test plan and test cases.
Perform system level use case analysis/profiling and feature return-on-investment investigations, prototype and validation, design methods and control policies to bring the new technology into production and transcend product goals.
Collaborate across System Architecture, DFT, ASIC, SW/FW, platform, validation, and production teams throughout the product life cycle on system-level architecture, design, productization, debugging, and deployment for complex silicon designs to improve quality, safety, and manufacturability.
Design tools/script to automate product definitions, data collection, test case execution, and results analysis. Provide detailed data analysis of functionality, performance, and latency.
Hands on actions on silicon bring-up, validation, and debug; Coordinate product level feature deployment to achieve high product quality at aggressive schedule.
NVIDIA-JR2025055.requirements:
Pursuing BS or MS degree in Microelectronics/Electronic Engineering/Computer and Related Professionals.
EE fundamentals, knowledgeable in digital design, computer architecture, power analysis, timing analysis, fault analysis, sampling, statistics, and scripting.
Experience in one or more areas of high-performance circuit (Low power, PLLs and clocking, SerDes and high-speed IO, SRAMs, power delivery/regulation, security circuits etc).
Good understanding of firmware/driver structures and their interaction with HW is a plus.
Experience with Python script development, Windows and Linux OS is a plus.
Hands-on lab experience with silicon bring up, frequency and power characterization, Tester to System correlation, lab tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, DAQ).
Excellent problem solving, collaborative, and interpersonal skills.
Excellent verbal communication and written, presentation skills in both Chinese and English.
Effective in a collaborative environment.
With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We welcome you join our team with some of the most hard-working people in the world working together to promote rapid growth. Are you passionate about becoming a part of a best-in-class team supporting the latest in GPU and AI technology? If so, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA-JR2025703.title: Silicon Performance, Power and Binning Tools Engineer
NVIDIA-JR2025703.description:
Every CPU, GPU, and Tegra SoC NVIDIA has shipped in the past four years passed through our toolchain on its way to production. Over 200 product SKUs were optimized during the Blackwell generation alone! Now we're looking for an engineer to help us rebuild that toolchain around AI.
We focus on the silicon layer of NVIDIA's productization work: the chip behavior piece. Our tools run the simulation, configuration, and data flow that take a chip's power, performance, and yield from pre-silicon estimates through to the values that ship in firmware and populate customer specs. This role is about making those tools talk to each other better, using AI to optimally move outputs from simulation into the downstream firmware, manufacturing, and specification systems that consume them.
What you'll be doing:
Build the infrastructure that turns raw simulation data (power, noise, binning yields, and more) into real firmware tuning, product specs, and manufacturing limits. You own the pipelines between tools.
Use LLMs and agents across the toolchain to automate the analysis, validation, and reporting work that currently costs engineering countless hours per chip.
Build the observability and validation systems that catch data errors and inconsistencies before they turn into release blockers.
Work with product convergence, silicon architecture, firmware, and manufacturing teams to translate new hardware requirements and capabilities into workflows that make it to production.
NVIDIA-JR2025703.requirements:
BS/MS in CS, CE, EE, or Systems Engineering, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of experience in a related hardware/software position
Strong understanding of digital design, circuit analysis, algorithms, computer architecture, silicon speed and power, BIOS, drivers, and software applications
Experience with Perl/Python, databases, and web applications
Strong fundamentals in software algorithms and object-oriented programming. Demonstrate ability to divide complex problems into simple sub-problems and reuse available solutions to solve a broad range of challenges efficiently
Hands-on experience applying LLMs to engineering problems: agents, MCP, RAG, or evaluation pipelines. Have shipped an LLM-backed feature in production and can tell us about a time you had to debug one.
Strong instincts for data quality: the automated checks, schema validation, and integration tests that keep pipelines trustworthy when inputs change.
You keep up with a fast-paced AI landscape and can distinguish which new tools matter and which are just hype
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Silicon product proficiency (speed, power, voltage noise, binning); MCP, DSPy, or LLM evaluation frameworks; Perl interop for legacy chip-data workflows; have crafted dashboards and visualizations for diverse collaborators.
Keeping up with every new feature and architectural change that NVIDIA packs into each chip generation is a real challenge. And because our users are directly on the path to production, support questions don't always wait for business hours. The payoff is that every product NVIDIA ships goes through the systems you'll help build. If that's the kind of problem you want to work on, we'd like to talk.

NVIDIA-JR2028298.title: System Software Engineer Intern, Embedded - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2028298.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world.
The NVIDIA Linux for Tegra team is looking for a System Software Engineer. You will work with the most advanced current and future generations of Tegra SOCs and products. You will join a team whose mission is to develop BSP/Security/Kernel on Tegra SOCs.
Our internships offer an excellent opportunity to expand your career and get hands on with one of our industry leading Software teams. We’re seeking strategic, ambitious, hard-working, and creative individuals who are passionate about helping us tackle challenges no one else can solve.
Throughout the minimum 24-week internship, students will work on projects that have a measurable impact on our business. We’re looking for students pursuing Bachelor's or Master's, within a relevant or related field.
What you'll be doing:
In this role, you will play a critical part in the stage of the BSP development of a Tegra SOC chip. You will work closely with team members and users to specify systems, build schedules, and handle ongoing feedback and improvement releases. You will learn and greatly improve the daily workflows of the world’s top chip modelers and designers.
Develop software tools/solutions to implement flashing/testing/OTA/security for BSP on Tegra platforms.
Provide solutions for various software issues in complex systems/applications.

A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience is required.
An understanding of Linux OS is a requirement.
Strong programming capability in C, Python, and shell.

Experience with the low-level software driver and bootloader is a huge plus.
Knowledge of security/trusted software would be very useful.
Strong English written and oral communication skills to collaborate with other engineers (worldwide)
A strong teammate, self-motivated with a good attitude, and the ability to work independently with minimal direction.

NVIDIA-JR2026177.description:
At present, NVIDIA is exploring the immense possibilities of AI to define the forthcoming era of computing. Our division develops compiler technologies within the CUDA software stack that support the transformation of high-level parallel programs into efficient performance on NVIDIA GPUs. This internship grants a hands-on experience working closely with compilers, GPU architecture, and parallel programming languages. The role is notable for its mix of systems perspective, software knowledge, and significant exposure to authentic compiler issues across advanced GPU platforms.

Develop programs in PTX, CUDA, C/C++, or low-level GPU languages to validate compiler and evaluate generated code across key features and architectures.
Build software components, libraries, and technical solutions that advance compiler development and open up more innovative ways to explore and exercise compiler behavior.
Collaborate with compiler and hardware engineers on challenging architectural and compiler interactions, helping uncover deeper insights into how advanced GPU software features behave across releases.
Contribute to expansive engineering projects that improve the robustness, scalability, and future-readiness of the CUDA software stack for new GPU platforms.

Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or similar languages used for systems or software development.
Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software debugging fundamentals.
Familiarity with compiler concepts, computer architecture, operating systems, or parallel programming.
Ability to read technical details carefully, reason about complex behaviors, and communicate findings clearly in a collaborative engineering environment.

Exposure to compiler internals, code generation, static analysis, LLVM, or MLIR.
Background in GPU programming, CUDA, PTX, or parallel computing models.
Hands-on project work involving low-level systems, program analysis, or software aimed at optimizing software operation.
Passion for compilers, GPU frameworks, or software tools intended for developer use.

NVIDIA-JR2027628.title: Applied Research Intern, Robotics - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2027628.description:
As a research intern on the embodied AI projects, you will help build the advanced robotic policies with humanoid robots for the challenging clinical environment scenes — enabling sim-first development, real-world deployment, and continuous learning to make them smarter over time. The ideal candidate will have strong research skills for robotics.
What You Will Be Doing:
Bring the latest advancements in embodied AI to simulated and real humanoid robots, successfully apply research in the challenging clinical environment scenes.
Upstream research results — into Isaac for Healthcare where they are clinical, and into Isaac and GR00T where they generalize.
Build sim-first robot policies with SimReady digital twin and minimize the sim2real gap.
Collaborate across team boundaries to integrate NVIDIA robotics products such as Jetson Thor, Isaac GR00T, Cosmos, and Isaac Sim/Lab into the research work.
Take on a variety of challenges, solve practical research topics.
Deploy and test the developed software on real humanoid robots.
NVIDIA-JR2027628.requirements:
Master's degree or above in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Skilled at robotic policy development workflow, from lab to launch: teleoperation, synthetic data generation, domain randomization, VLA and RL post-training, sim2real transfer, deployment with edge AI platforms.
Familiar with the latest research work in VLA and RL algorithms.
Proficiency in Python, PyTorch. Willingness to learn new languages and robot SDK tools as needed.
Ability to adapt to fast-paced development lifecycles, multi-functional organizations, new technologies and platforms.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to determine the best approach to complex challenges.
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to working effectively with diverse teams.
Ways to Stand out from The Crowd:
Familiarity with the latest embodied AI research work.
Experience with VLA / Reinforcement Learning.
Experience with humanoid robots.
Familiarity with NVIDIA robotics products such as Jetson, Isaac GR00T, Cosmos, and Isaac Sim/Lab.

NVIDIA-JR2026580.title: Business Development Management Intern - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2026580.description:
Do you want to help advance AI by connecting breakthrough technology with developers, researchers, startups, and industry leaders across China? NVIDIA’s Worldwide Field Operations China team is looking for a Business Development Intern to help us grow strategic accounts and strengthen the AI developer ecosystem. Together, we work with developers, researchers, startups, independent software vendors, and customers across industries including internet services, cloud computing, and IoT.
In this internship, you will gain hands-on experience in ecosystem development, go-to-market execution, and strategic business development. We will help you build knowledge of NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform—from the data center to the edge—while you collaborate with teams across Business Development, Solutions Architecture, Software and Hardware Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Support strategic account and partnership initiatives by coordinating research, materials, and follow-up activities across teams.
Build an understanding of NVIDIA’s AIPS sales motion by working closely with Solutions Architecture and DevTech teams to accelerate library integration and drive adoption.
Engage with developers, researchers, software partners, and technology decision-makers to gain a deeper understanding of customer workloads and turn your findings into practical insights.
Prepare customer and partner profiles, meeting materials, internal updates, and recommendations that help our teams make informed decisions.
Collect and organize customer feedback, feature requests, and market requirements for relevant product and technical teams.
Coordinate technical meetups, research conferences, community activities, and industry events, including outreach, attendee tracking, and post-event reporting.
Work with account managers and business development teams on projects that support NVIDIA’s strategic accounts and broader AI ecosystem.
NVIDIA-JR2026580.requirements:
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
An interest in AI, machine learning, accelerated computing, cloud technologies, or developer ecosystems, along with a willingness to keep learning.
The ability to research unfamiliar topics, organize information, identify useful insights, and communicate clear recommendations.
Clear written and verbal communication skills in both Chinese and English.
Experience using productivity and collaboration tools, with an openness to learning new AI-enabled tools.
The ability to take ownership of defined assignments, ask thoughtful questions, and work well with people from different functions.
Availability to meet the internship schedule agreed upon with the team.
Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
Coursework, projects, internships, student organizations, or event experience related to AI, cloud computing, startups, developer communities, or business development.
Examples of using research or data to identify trends, explain an opportunity, or recommend an action.
Experience supporting events, communities, outreach programs, or cross-functional projects.
Curiosity about how AI technology creates customer value and business impact.
A learning-oriented approach, thoughtful follow-through, and a willingness to contribute new ideas.
You will have opportunities to learn from experienced business and technical teams, understand how NVIDIA brings AI solutions to market, and contribute to projects involving customers and ecosystem partners. You will also gain exposure to NVIDIA technologies, developer programs, and real-world applications of accelerated computing. We are building an environment where people can learn, contribute, and do their best work together. Join us and help shape how AI reaches developers, businesses, and communities across China!
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available to candidates who need assistance during the application or interview process.

NVIDIA-JR2028952.title: Business Development Manager - Robotics
NVIDIA-JR2028952.description:
We are hiring a Robotics Business Development (BD) Manager! NVIDIA leads the world in Artificial Intelligence. In recent years, its powerful GPU-based computers have supported Deep Learning, Generative AI, accelerated analytics, autonomous vehicles, and robotics globally. NVIDIA serves major technology companies in sectors such as Manufacturing, Automotive, Aerospace, and Healthcare. The company maintains a top position as the ‘AI Computing Company’. The BD Manager will promote growth and expansion of our robotics 3-computer business. The role includes finding new business opportunities, creating strategic alliances, and growing NVIDIA’s robotics market share.
What you’ll be doing:
Engage in one of today’s most exciting and dynamic technology fields. Promote the adoption of NVIDIA 3-computer platforms within the robotics ecosystem. This includes robotics OEMs, model builders, platforms, data, and sensors.
Build strategic relationships with robotics ecosystem partners and complete go-to-market strategies aligned with global and regional priorities.
Encourage strong cooperation among all participants in the robotics partner network.
Collaborate across key internal functions including engineering, sales, marketing, and executive teams.
Pursue both short-term and long-term revenue opportunities.
Forecast and hit revenue targets in support of the above objectives.
Contribute to high-profile industry events and technical meetups.
Gather and relay product development requirements derived from customer engagements and field implementations.
Continuously find opportunities to highlight customer successes: partner with marketing to package success stories and participate in product launches and industry events.
NVIDIA-JR2028952.requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or Ph.D. is a plus.
8+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, technology sales, or ecosystem development within robotics, AI, autonomous systems, or related industries.
Solid understanding of Physical AI and robotics technologies, including robotics foundation models, data collection and curation, synthetic data generation, simulation, reinforcement learning, and manipulation.
Good communication skills to manage relationships with the key technical developer in communities. Able to lead and interact with cross-functional team members to accomplish project tasks and goals.
Familiarity with robotics hardware and enabling technologies, particularly dexterous hands, manipulation systems, sensors, and related components.
Experience building and carrying out a sophisticated sales strategy across multiple organizations.
Experience in qualifying new customers to enable high growth revenue opportunities, product alignment, decision makers, etc.
Flexible and a resilient problem solver.
Proficiency in spoken and written English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
A well-established network across the Physical AI ecosystem, particularly in robotics data, generated datasets, emulation environments, dexterous manipulation, and robotics foundation models.
Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives and lines of businesses across organizations.
Intellectual curiosity and passion for innovation.

NVIDIA-JR2027176.description:

DFT logic implementation and verification

Pattern generation and bringup

NVIDIA-JR2023910.title: Energy Solution Architect
NVIDIA-JR2023910.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
What you’ll be doing:
We'll have the outstanding opportunity to be at the forefront of energy innovation!
As an Energy Solution Architect, we expect to provide dedicated technical support for energy customers, driving solution development and hands-on enablement for domain-specific simulation and surrogate modeling use cases across multiple NVIDIA software stacks.
Your efforts will encourage and grow China’s energy ecosystem, giving solutions that can scale to the global NVIDIA energy vertical.
NVIDIA-JR2023910.requirements:
5+ years experience in the new energy sector (i.e. green energy, energy storage, battery, or power systems).
Practical knowledge of GPU computing (CUDA, HPC workloads, or accelerated simulation) is vital.
Familiarity with scientific computing and simulation tools like CFD, FEM, molecular dynamics, or physics-based AI models is meaningful.
Customer-facing experience is needed, including PoC delivery, developing solutions, or technical consulting.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with engineering, sales, and product teams are important.
A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (Physics, Energy Engineering, Computer Science, or related) is highly encouraged.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
Direct experience with PhysicsNeMo, Omniverse/OpenUSD, or NVIDIA HPC SDK applied to energy or scientific simulation will position you as an outstanding candidate.
Deep knowledge in new energy, renewable energy systems, or AI-for-science workflows, paired with proven success in moving customer PoCs into production within energy or industrial verticals.
Bridge modern AI and simulation research with actual energy industry implementations.
Passion for building a new vertical from the ground up — entrepreneurial approach with the ability to identify and shape emerging opportunities
Prior contributions to open-source scientific computing or published research in energy/physics domains

NVIDIA-JR2027189.title: Global Commodity Manager, Passive Electrical Commodity
NVIDIA-JR2027189.description:
We are looking for a committed supply chain expert! The Global Commodity Manager (GCM) is a key player in making sure the company’s products are cost-effective and that the supply chain is resilient and responsive to market changes. In this role, GCM is responsible for making sure that our company gets the best quality and price for these commodities, as well as minimizing the risks and disruptions in the supply chain. You will be involved in strategic sourcing by collaborating with engineering, BU, finance, and global operations organizations. Your effective ability to work with suppliers, CMs and the cross functional teams will directly impact our business success.
Besides managing the commodities, we also hope that the professional can use data analysis and digital transformation to improve the supply chain process with a demonstrated history of success in their career.
What you’ll be doing:
Develop and execute company’s commodities strategy: overseeing sourcing strategy for specific commodities across NPI through Mass Production.
Deploy global supply chain activities, risk mitigation and higher resiliency in reaction to new requirements of compliance.
Evaluate, select, and qualify suppliers: recommending new suppliers to stakeholders through alternative sourcing for the best benefit of company.
Work with suppliers to optimize cost, supply flexibility and quality performance and manage CMs to execute the cost reduction initiatives.
Market intelligence: assess through multiple information sources to follow market trends and proactively identify potential supply chain issues, followed effective risk mitigation.
Act as higher level of escalation point for supply disruption issues, taking efficient and strategic actions to prevent and solve complex issues for revenue attainment.
Collaborate with cross-functional Operations teams and leverage Power BI and other digital tools to optimize supply chain processes and improve collaboration amongst Operations team.
Analyze data and present results to help management identify key trends for decision making in a variety of domains.
NVIDIA-JR2027189.requirements:
Bachelor’s degree and above: majored in engineering or supply chain management, etc.
Professional Certification like CPSM/CIPS/CPPM/PMP is preferred.
8+ years in sourcing, supply chain or commodity management specifically in passive electrical commodities.
Experience of EMS factory supply chain management, knowledge about data center and networking products is a plus.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including advanced Excel, data modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, predictive or statistical analysis, and clear communication of supply chain metrics.
Hands-on experience with BI, automation, or AI-enabled tools.·
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good English command with the ability to present to management required.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Passion to success and perfection.
Committed partnership collaborations.
Knowledgeable with proven experience on low-code or no-code platforms and modern productivity AI tools.

NVIDIA-JR2020882.title: Global Supply Manager
NVIDIA-JR2020882.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people on the planet working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
We are now seeking a senior level supply chain management professional – Global Supply Manager (GSM) to lead materials readiness, supply visibility, and Clear-to-Build (CTB) execution for complex networking product. This role is responsible for ensuring turnkey materials do not become a constraint to critical AI infrastructure high volume products, while driving stronger planning discipline, faster shortage resolution, and better decision-making through data, automation, and AI-enabled workflows. The successful candidate will work closely with Global commodity team, Engineering, Contract Manufacturers (CMs), and component Suppliers to improve material availability, strengthen operational processes, and build scalable reporting and analytics. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong supply chain judgment, structured problem-solving, and the ability to turn data into action.
What you’ll be doing:
Own the Clear-to-Build (CTB) process, providing clear visibility to material readiness, projected coverage, and key constraints that may impact build plans and customer commitments.
Partner with CMs, suppliers, distributors, Global Commodity team (GCM) and Engineering to manage material risk, resolve shortages, and prevent turnkey materials from landing on the critical path.
Serve as a senior escalation point for material issues from the CMs, driving timely actions on expedites, recovery plans, and alternate supply or engineering solutions through closure.
Review and strengthen CM materials management processes, including controls for supply-demand alignment, site balance, safety stock, and excess and obsolete (E&O) mitigation.
Drive accountability for accurate and timely supply-demand reporting from CMs, with clear follow-up on critical shortages, gaps, and recovery actions.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce lead times, improve material availability, and increase overall supply chain efficiency and execution quality.
Build and enhance data intelligence capabilities using tools such as Power BI and modern AI / low-code platforms to improve visibility, analysis, reporting, and collaboration across internal teams and external partners.
Prepare executive-ready updates on material availability, supply risk, and key performance indicators for cross-functional and leadership reviews.
NVIDIA-JR2020882.requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in supply chain, operations, industrial engineering, business, or a related field.
10+ years of recent experience in materials planning, materials management, or supply chain operations, particularly on PCBA board/ system products or Optics module/ systems, with in-depth understanding on EE, Mechanical, interconnector supply base.
Strong experience with EMS industry supply chain processes and Contract Manufacturer management.
Proven ability to solve complex operational problems and influence stakeholders through data, structured analysis, and clear communication.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including advanced Excel, data modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, predictive or statistical analysis, and clear communication of supply chain metrics.
Hands-on experience with BI, automation, or AI-enabled tools; experience with low-code or no-code platforms and modern productivity AI tools is a strong plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present effectively to executive management.

NVIDIA-JR2025542.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
The Isaac Loco-Manipulation team develops innovative robot learning technologies that enable humanoid and mobile robots for complex dexterous manipulation and loco-manipulation tasks. This internship combines ambitious applied research and thorough engineering across GR00T and Cosmos foundation models, Isaac Lab, Newton, synthetic data generation, simulation, and physical robot testing. As an intern, you will own a focused applied research project and collaborate with world-class researchers and engineers to turn novel ideas into validated robot capabilities. This outstanding opportunity allows you to immerse yourself in the forefront of AI and robotics, making a lasting impact on the future of technology.
What you’ll be doing:
Develop novel robot learning methods for advancing performance in humanoids and mobile manipulators for whole-body dexterous tasks.
Co-develop and advance GR00T and Cosmos robotics foundation models.
Develop robot-learning technologies to enable large scale deployment of robot autonomy.
Lead an applied research project from idea conception, prototype development, publication, and software open-source contribution.
NVIDIA-JR2025542.requirements:
Pursuing a PhD degree or Master Degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Proven strong robotics research or engineering experience through academic projects, publications, and real robot experience.
Proficiency in Python and C++, with hands-on experience using deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
Experience with physics simulators like Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or MuJoCo and transferring data or behaviors between simulated and physical systems.
Experience with world modeling and world action models.
Project or research experience in robot learning, including imitation learning or reinforcement learning, and robotics foundation models.

Strong publication record in leading robotics, computer-vision, or machine-learning journals or conferences such as CoRL, RSS, Science Robotics, ICRA, and CVPR.
Experience in learning robot behaviors from human videos or demonstrations.
Research or project depth in dexterous bimanual manipulation, whole-body control, or humanoid robotics.

NVIDIA-JR2022811.title: Manager, Solutions Architecture - Data Processing
NVIDIA-JR2022811.description:
NVIDIA is currently seeking a Solutions Architect Manager for Data Processing! Would you enjoy researching new algorithms and memory management techniques to accelerate data processing on modern computer architectures? Do you like investigating hardware and system bottlenecks, and optimizing performance of data intensive applications? Are you excited about the opportunity to work on the top tier edge of technology with both visibility and impact to the success of a leader like NVIDIA? If so, the Solution Architecture Team invites you to consider this opportunity. NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, revolutionized parallel computing, and ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human imagination and intelligence; join our team today!
What you will be doing:
In this role, you will lead a data processing SA team to research and develop techniques to GPU-accelerate high performance database, ETL and data analytics applications and new AI data processing technologies.
Work closely in China To4++ in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex data intensive workloads to ensure the best possible performance of current GPU/CPU architectures.
Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA
Influence partners (industry and academia) to push the bounds of data processing with NVIDIA’s full product line
NVIDIA-JR2022811.requirements:
Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree or equivalent experience.
8+ overall years of experience including 3 years management experience
Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software design.
Hands-on experience with low-level parallel programming, e.g. CUDA (preferred), OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, pthreads, TBB, etc.
In-depth expertise with CPU/GPU architecture fundamentals, especially memory subsystem.
Domain expertise in high performance databases, ETL, data analytics and/or vector database.
Good communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, and prioritization skills.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience optimizing/implementing database operators or query planner, especially for parallel or distributed frameworks (e.g. production database or Spark).
Background with optimizing vector database index build and/or search.
Experience profiling and optimizing CUDA kernels.
Background with compression, storage systems, networking, and distributed computer architectures.
Data Analytics is one of the rapidly growing fields in GPU accelerated computing. Data preprocessing and data engineering are traditionally CPU based and are becoming the bottleneck for Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) applications, as performance of the frameworks and core ML/DL libraries has been highly optimized leveraging GPUs. Many of today’s applications have complex data analytics pipelines that can benefit from optimizations in memory management, compression, parallel algorithms like sort, search, join, aggregation, groupby, scaling up to multi GPU systems, and scaling out to many nodes. Take a look at some of the open-source projects that NVIDIA employees have worked on:
RAPIDS cuDF
,
NVIDIA nvcomp
,
NVIDIA Distributed join
,
NVIDIA cuCollections .
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA-JR2023299.title: NPI Materials Planner
NVIDIA-JR2023299.description:
NVIDIA has an exciting opportunity for a Materials Planner in our Quick Turn/ NPI Materials Organization. The position requires exceptional materials management skills and supply planning expertise in a dynamic and fast paced environment. The ideal candidate would have a deep understanding of procurement, planning, and contract manufacturing supply chain in multinational manufacturing industry.
What you’ll be doing:
Collaborate effectively with Engineering Program Mgmt. teams to understand build requirements for new products supporting bring-up boards for validation and qualification. Support the engineers’ requests on material transition, samples delivery, deviation release.
Manage build schedule shortages impacting CTB (clear to build) and work with materials support team on materials supply risk mitigation.
Effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams including GCM, engineering, manufacturing, to ensure alignment on NPI material requirements and build timelines. Use data analytics to identify and address potential roadblocks or challenges.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance NPI supply chain efficiency and effectiveness. Find opportunities to streamline processes, reduce lead times, and improve overall supply chain performance.
Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks using data analytics. Develop data-driven contingency plans and alternative sourcing strategies to minimize the impact of potential disruptions.
Manage consigned material demand in ERP system and follow through with internal teams to ensure consigned materials readiness to schedule, manage the consigned inventory with accurate allocation and excess disposition.
Monitor BOM changes and ensure all changes are identified and loaded accurately through MRP/SAP system.
Consolidate results and provide updates to cross functional teams on material status for all assigned NPI builds. Run review meetings with internal (engineering and operations) and external teams (CMs) to align build schedules.
Prepare and communicate critical Materials availability updates to cross functional leadership teams; maintain executive reports and summaries, providing accurate and timely data to leadership on agreed cadence.
NVIDIA-JR2023299.requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in operations, IE, supply chain or Business preferred, with 7+ years most recent experience in materials management, production planning, or supply chain management.
Experience with ERP/MRP demand planning and forecasting tools, rich experience on different commodities including EE, Mech, Interconnector etc. along with strong understanding of NPI processes and supply chain dynamics.
Experience working with BOM in OEM/CM environment required.
Project skills and expertise on AI-driven tools design/ development as business user is a strong plus.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Proven experience in materials planning or supply chain management, preferably in a manufacturing or high-tech industry.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in data analytics and advanced AI tools.
With equal opportunities, competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our outstanding operations teams are rapidly growing. NVIDIA-JR2024109.title: NVIDIA 2027 New College Graduate: Autonomous Vehicles and Robotics - China
NVIDIA-JR2024109.description:
By submitting your resume, you’re expressing interest in in one of our 2027 Autonomous Vehicles and Robotics – New College Grad roles. We’ll review resumes on an ongoing basis, and a recruiter may reach out if your experience fits one of our new college graduate opportunities. NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to tackle challenges no one else can solve. Our work in AI and digital twins is transforming the world's largest industries and profoundly impacting society — from gaming to robotics, self-driving cars to life-saving healthcare, climate change to virtual worlds where we can all connect and create.
We offer an excellent opportunity to expand your career and get hands on experience with one of our industry leading Autonomous Vehicles and Robotics teams. We’re seeking strategic, ambitious, hard-working, and creative individuals who are passionate about helping us tackle challenges no one else can solve.
Potential NCG opportunities in this field include:
Autonomous Vehicles
Developing and training state-of-the-art Deep Neural Networks for path generation
Collecting training datasets and real-time inference run-times using simulators/gyms as well as performing in-vehicle tests
Robotics:
Embodied AI:
Build and deploy full-stack embodied AI systems for dexterous manipulation, whole-body control, and sensorized human-robot interaction, leveraging NVIDIA Isaac, Omniverse, and Cosmos to bridge simulation and real-world deployment across industrial and everyday environments.
Simulation
: Build and scale core simulation and training infrastructure on Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, combining high-fidelity physics and GPU computing to accelerate sim-to-real transfer for next-generation humanoid robots.
Deployment

NVIDIA-JR2027182.title: Planning and Control Adaptation Intern, Autonomous Driving - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2027182.description:
Are you looking to be part of a fun, creative company at the forefront of groundbreaking technologies? NVIDIA is leading the way in some of the world's most exciting tech areas, including Virtual Reality, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and Autonomous Vehicles. We are widely recognized as one of the most desirable employers, with some of the most forward-thinking individuals in the industry working with us. There has never been a more exciting time to join our team!
We are looking for a highly motivated Planning and Control Adaptation Intern to join our autonomous driving team. You will work with experienced engineers to support Planning and Control integration and adaptation across multiple vehicle platforms, while gaining hands-on experience in issue analysis, algorithm validation, and engineering tool development.
What You Will Be Doing:
Support Planning and Control integration, parameter tuning, and adaptation across vehicle platforms with different dynamics, steering and braking systems, and actuator configurations.
Analyze driving issues involving path and speed planning, lane changes, merging, yielding, intersections, and lateral and longitudinal control.
Use simulation, replay tools, and vehicle logs to reproduce issues, investigate root causes, and validate improvements.
Perform cross-carline testing and evaluate driving safety, comfort, smoothness, and robustness.
Develop Python or C++ tools for log analysis, parameter comparison, regression testing, and result visualization.
Collaborate with Planning and Control engineers on integration, validation, and delivery for production autonomous driving programs.
NVIDIA-JR2027182.requirements:
Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Automotive Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Good C++ or Python programming skills, with familiarity with Linux development and software debugging workflows.
Basic understanding of motion planning, vehicle control, vehicle kinematics or dynamics, or numerical optimization, with strong analytical, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
Proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global teams.
Able to work at least three days per week throughout the internship.
Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
Research, internship, or competition experience related to autonomous driving or robotics.
Familiarity with path planning, trajectory optimization, MPC, PID, A*, Hybrid A*, or related algorithms.
Experience with ROS, Apollo, Autoware, CARLA, CarMaker, or similar platforms.
Experience with vehicle logs, CAN signals, simulation, parameter tuning, or engineering tool development.

NVIDIA-JR2025535.title: Power Analysis and Optimization Intern - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2025535.description:
NVIDIA is committed not only to delivering outstanding chip performance, but also to improving power efficiency across every product. Performance per watt is critical to our success. The Power Analysis and Optimization team helps IP teams define power targets for architectural changes and new features, identify power-saving opportunities throughout the ASIC design process—from architecture definition through place and route—and resolve power issues that could affect functionality or performance.
As an intern,
you will gain hands-on experience in ASIC power analysis, modeling, optimization, and automation while contributing to more energy-efficient NVIDIA products.
What you’ll be doing:
Support the development of IP-level power models for early power estimation of architectural changes and new features.
Assist IP teams in analyzing power consumption across different workloads and application scenarios.
Use internally developed flows and industry-standard tools to perform power analysis and identify optimization opportunities.
Work with design teams to evaluate proposed power optimizations.
Develop scripts and automation flow to improve the work efficiency.
NVIDIA-JR2025535.requirements:
Currently pursuing a BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Basic understanding of digital circuit design, computer architecture, or ASIC design methodology.
Familiarity with power consumption concepts and common low-power design techniques.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Coursework or project experience in RTL design, synthesis, physical design, or computer architecture.
Familiarity with power-analysis tools such as PrimeTime PX or PowerArtist.
Experience with power modeling, workload analysis, or low-power design.
Experience building or integrating AI agents/skills.
NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology industry’s most desirable employers, bringing together some of the world’s most talented and innovative people. Are you creative, analytical, and eager to improve the power efficiency of cutting-edge GPU and SoC designs? Do you enjoy understanding complex architectures, analyzing power behavior, and finding opportunities to improve performance per watt? If so, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA-JR2023506.title: Product Manager - Open Models
NVIDIA-JR2023506.description:
Ready to drive transformation in AI models? At NVIDIA, our team focuses on improving community models like Qwen, Kimi, Minimax, StepFun. As a Product Manager for Open Models, you will work with groundbreaking technology to accelerate researchers' and developers' success. Join our team in China known for their dedication to collaboration and outstanding performance.
What you’ll be doing:
Collaborating with community model builders to ensure seamless model support, early access collaboration, and go-to-market alignment.
Tracking emerging trends in the open model space and assess technical differentiators and ecosystem impact of new releases.
Supporting product marketing in crafting model-specific messaging and documentation - including blogs, whitepapers, case studies, and presentations, highlighting NVIDIA’s optimizations and software tools.
Collaborating closely with internal engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience teams to enable best-in-class support for open models across inference, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
Facilitating feedback loops between our platform and model builders to continuously improve performance, usability, and compatibility.
Work with executives to launch new products and support keynotes.
NVIDIA-JR2023506.requirements:
7+ years of meaningful work experience in product management or technical partner management.
BS or MS or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science, or another technical field. MBA a plus.
Knowledge of the community model ecosystem, including Hugging Face, PyTorch, and inference frameworks like Ollama, SGLang, and vLLM.
Comfortable reviewing Python code used in presentations, demos, and articles.
Comfortable with digital marketing and social media.
Excellent written and spoken communication skills, including strong Microsoft products and markdown skills, with the ability to translate between partner requirements and internal priorities.
You love to thrive in a cross-functional organization, by collaborating with peers across teams and functions.
Deep organizational skills, capable of balancing multiple projects at the same time.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Product manager experience at a company training frontier AI models.
Hands-on experience with quantization, distillation, or low-rank adaptation techniques and running community models on NVIDIA GPUs.
Hardworking and highly motivated with measurable results (metrics, awards, key accomplishments) you can share.
A growing portfolio of blogs and social posts with links to your relevant work, including technical writing, social media presence, videos, and research papers.
With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most hard-working and dedicated people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our special engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

At NVIDIA, we are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible within self-driving vehicle technology by bringing to bear the power of Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL). As a world leader in AI and high-performance computing, NVIDIA provides an outstanding platform where innovative research meets real-world production. We are looking for a Reinforcement Learning Intern to join our mission in building intelligent, safe, and efficient self-driving technology that will redefine transportation on a global scale.

Research, prototype, and implement state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms for autonomous vehicle decision-making and trajectory planning.
Assist in developing and scaling training pipelines and simulation environments for complex RL experiments.
Collaborate closely with senior researchers and engineers across perception and planning teams to integrate RL models into the autonomous driving stack.
Analyze and benchmark RL model performance against imitation learning and traditional baselines in complex urban simulation scenarios.
Explore techniques to optimize and lightweight RL policies for real-time deployment on automotive hardware.

Hands-on project or academic research experience developing and training deep RL algorithms using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Strong programming skills in Python and foundational familiarity with C++.
Great eagerness to learn, strong problem-solving abilities, and excellent communication skills for collaborative team research.

Publication record at top-tier AI/Robotics conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, IROS, ICRA, CoRL) or relevant open-source contributions in RL or autonomous driving.
Research exposure to generative modeling (e.g., Flow Matching, Diffusion, AR decoders) applied to trajectory prediction or world models.
Experience addressing compounding errors, distribution shift, or safety constraints in robotic control and autonomous navigation simulation environments.

NVIDIA-JR2028022.title: Reinforcement Learning and World Model for Autonomous Simulation Intern - 2027
NVIDIA-JR2028022.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
We are in search of a hardworking intern with expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Multi-Modal World Simulation Model to propel the evolution of ML-centric autonomous driving and Physical AI solutions. The focus of this role lies in model-centric RL, learning about world simulation models, and translating state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithms into real-world applications, allowing vehicles to interpret, anticipate, and respond astutely in challenging dynamic contexts. This is a great opportunity to shape the next frontier of intelligent driving, where imagination meets real-world impact. If you’re excited by the idea of building SOTA simulation techs and systems that learn, adapt, and truly “think,” we’d love to have you on board. Join us, join a team where your input plays a crucial role in fast-tracking the growth of autonomous vehicles with the state of art solutions.
What you'll be doing:
Develop and refine multi-modal world models and integrate them into our simulation system.
Train and evaluate self-supervised latent dynamics and sensor generation models for the joint tasks of trajectory prediction, goal-conditioned ego control, and sensor data synthesis. Explore and prototype hybrid architectures combining world models, generative (e.g., diffusion, flow matching) models, and policy gradients for realistic and robust simulation.
Collaborate with End-to-End Driving Model teams to deploy world-model-based policies to simulated RL environments and accelerate the training of the driving systems.
Contribute to system development for continuous learning and simulation adaptation (Sim2Real transfer).
NVIDIA-JR2028022.requirements:
Pursuing PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, with neural rendering, robotics, or simulation background.
Strong understanding of reinforcement learning (policy gradients, actor-critic, offline RL).
Familiarity with visual representation learning and 4D scene representation (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, occupancy networks and contrastive, masked modeling, or generative world simulation) for world simulation.
Experience building large-scale training pipelines with temporal consistency and simulation data replay.
Publications or open-source contributions in RL, model-based control, or autonomous systems.
Passion for developing learning systems that can “imagine” and plan in the real world.

NVIDIA-JR2020063.title: Sales Operation Specialist
NVIDIA-JR2020063.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and diligent Sales Operation Specialist to support our fast-growing business in China.
The ideal candidate will collaborate with Sales, Sales Ops, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to track business performance, handle demand signals, and support data-driven decisions in a fast-changing, supply-limited setting.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Develop and maintain regular sales reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) covering revenue, bookings, backlog, shipment status, and product- and customer-level performance.
Build dashboards to track key benchmarks such as forecast vs. actuals, supply allocation, and order fulfillment status, and provide actionable insights on trends, gaps, and risks.
Support rolling forecast processes with a 12–18 month outlook. Consolidate demand inputs from sales teams and key customers. Identify gaps between forecast, allocation, and actual orders.
Highlight risks including supply shortages, credit limitations, and delayed PO releases.
Monitor the order pipeline (PO status, CRD, MAD), analyze backlog movement, push-outs, and cancellations, and support critical issues for urgent deliveries and allocation prioritization.
Maintain data accuracy throughout systems including SAP, SFDC, and internal tools.
Track price changes, rebates, and program compliance, and validate deal structures against company policies.
Work closely with sales, supply chain, and finance groups to coordinate demand visibility, allocation, shipment updates, and revenue tracking.
Find opportunities to streamline reporting and analytics processes, automate recurring reports, and improve data quality.
NVIDIA-JR2020063.requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Around 5 years of experience in Sales Analytics, Sales Operations, or Supply Chain Analysis.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with Power BI or similar tools.
Experience working with ERP/CRM platforms such as SAP or Salesforce is preferred.
Strong customer orientation.
Strong communication skills in both English and Mandarin.
Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
Experience supporting large enterprise customers or high-volume sales businesses.
Familiarity with supply-constrained and distribution-focused environments.
Knowledge of the semiconductor, networking, or IT hardware industry. A data-driven approach with strong problem-solving skills.
Ability to work under pressure, prioritize multiple tasks, and communicate proactively. A collaborative approach when working across cross-functional teams.
